entities.summary: The page provides information about the processing of personal data when applying for a visa, including categories of personal data processed and where these data come from. It also outlines purposes and legal bases for data processing, as well as how long data are used for.

official_links.title: Bundesbeauftragte für den Datenschutz und die Informationsfreiheit

important_notes: The Federal Foreign Office and German missions abroad are responsible for the processing of personal data when applying for a visa.

Personal data include items such as surname, first name, date and place (including country) of birth, gender, nationality/nationalities, marital status, current address, telephone number, email address, occupation, travel document details, photograph and fingerprints.
The legal basis is provided by Art. 6 (1) (c) and (e) as well as Art. 6 (2) of the GDPR in conjunction with Regulation (EC) No. 767/2008 (VIS Regulation) and Regulation (EC) No. 810/2009 (Visa Code).
Your data are deleted as soon as they are no longer required for the processing of the visa application.
Data are transmitted to third parties only where necessary to ensure the proper processing of the visa application.

data_protection_rights.right: Right of access (Article 15 of the GDPR)
data_protection_rights.description: You have the right to obtain information about the personal data that are stored in a controller's processing system and to receive copies of this information.

data_protection_rights.right: Right to rectification (Article 16 of the GDPR)
data_protection_rights.description: You have the right to request that inaccurate or incomplete personal data be corrected.

data_protection_rights.right: Right to erasure (Article 17 of the GDPR)
data_protection_rights.description: You have the right to request that your personal data be erased if it is no longer necessary for the purposes for which it was collected, and you do not object to further processing.

data_protection_rights.right: Right to restriction of processing (Article 18 of the GDPR)
data_protection_rights.description: You have the right to restrict certain types of processing of your personal data if you object to their use but agree that they should be retained for a specific purpose, and you do not object to further processing.

data_protection_rights.right: Right to data portability (Article 20 of the GDPR)
data_protection_rights.description: You have the right to receive copies of your personal data in a structured, commonly used and machine-readable format, or to transmit them to another controller if technically feasible.

data_protection_rights.right: Right to object to processing (Article 21 of the GDPR)
data_protection_rights.description: You have the right to object to certain types of processing of your personal data, including automated decision-making based on profiling.

data_protection_authorities.name: Federal Commissioner for Data Protection and Freedom of Information
